svg.title: PySpark on YARN -- End-to-End Cluster & Shuffle Architecture
svg.desc: Submission, AM & Python bootstrap, RM registration, executor RPC, cross-worker shuffle fetch, and driver HDFS commit across all 6 host zones. 1. YARN Client to ResourceManager: submitApplication(AM) (rm01:8032); 2. ApplicationMaster to Python Driver: Spawn orders.py & init SparkContext (driver-1 OS); 3. ApplicationMaster to ResourceManager: registerAM & request executors (rm01:8030); 4. ExecBackend A to DriverSchedBackend: RegisterExecutor(id=1) (driver-1:41000); 5. DriverSchedBackend to ExecBackend A: LaunchTask(Map 0.0) (worker-a:ephemeral); 6. DriverSchedBackend to ExecBackend B: LaunchTask(Reduce p42) (worker-b:ephemeral); 7. Shuffle Reader to BlockTransferSvc: FetchShuffleBlock(0_12_42) (worker-a:42001); 8. Driver Commit to HDFS NameNode: commitJob() (FileOutputCommitter Algo 1) (nn01:8020)
